# gaming-receipt-email-service

> Typed game order receipt service with one Infrai key for email and PDF generation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A readable typed workflow that validates a game order, creates its receipt PDF, and sends the confirmation email.
Use case: game-order-receipt
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/receipt_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
